articles.summary: CALGARY, Alberta, July 13, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Enerflex Ltd. (TSX: EFX) (NYSE: EFXT) (“Enerflex” or the “Company”) today announced that Fernando Assing will resign from the Board of Directors (the “Board”) effective July 17, 2026, to allow him to focus on other professional commitments,
articles.title: Enerflex Ltd. Announces Director Resignation
